label: Time-indexed fresh material tokens under reciprocal regeneration
definition: Token contains a Nat tick and Bool production role. present n c means c.tick=n. run begins with full occupancy and repeatedly applies regenerate true. Every tick has full occupancy but no token present at n is present at n+1. Token tick is a material cohort convention, not an organism or event identity criterion.
note: Analyst complete-replacement fixture. Biological timescales, mechanisms and applicability remain open. See docs/notes/life-restricted-composition-327.md.
